exploreUrl.text:
Search state lives in the URL (shareable, back button works):
/tx/travis/explore?at=30.4394,-97.6200&r=5&roof=15&permit=open,stalled&tenure=10&ooa=1&layers=roof,permits,gaps&z=13&sort=open_desc&sel=p_101

at = ring centre (pin, place or GPS) · r = radius in mi (0.5–25) · roof = roof age ≥ N yrs · permit = statuses · tenure = owner tenure > N yrs · ooa = out-of-area owner · layers · z = zoom · sort · sel = selected property. Values in this example are Sample.

crmLeadsUrl.text:
Leads state lives in the URL (shareable, reload and back keep it):
/leads?status=new,contacted&roof=15&permit=open,stalled&openYrs=5&place={id}&r=5&sort=near&page=2

status = any mix of new, contacted, qualified, won, lost · assignee = me (default), all (sales-manager view) or a name · roof = roof age ≥ N yrs · permit = open, stalled or both (none = Any) · openYrs = permit open ≥ N yrs · place + r = within r mi of an Area (0.5–25) · sort = activity, roof, open, near · page. Defaults are left out. A signed-out link goes to sign-in, then back to the same list. Show on map opens CrmMap?leads={ids}. Values are Sample.
